steps: From the initialized official blank template with zero documents/assets/registrations, create and ordinarily save the first definition through Studio.
Create a saved custom Enter action, two-member assembly and Level HUD through their ordinary UI forms. No input map, member relationship or HUD is seeded by the harness.

Before the first behavior Save, actual JSON controls retain unfinished/duplicate input; switching bindings and three languages retain complete raw fragments. Review preserves 1e2, -0 and escaped CRLF; explicit Add missing revokes review, changes only that binding and Cancel writes nothing. Outer textarea CRLF normalization is recorded, not treated as lossless paste.

The final first behavior transaction contains one configured retry binding at creation time. Only manifest source, its registration and the scene behavior relation change; the reviewed raw fragment is saved exactly, ordinary reload retains them, and exactly one behavior.create apply is observed. No empty-parameter manifest is saved and later patched.
Retain the eight-document author workspace and capture its valid two-scene project plan; actual Godot keyboard input remains a separate verification task.

limitations: The harness initializes the official blank template layout with one generic document type and zero authored documents/assets/registrations. It does not automate desktop-library project creation, native folder pickers, installed Tauri or Android.

Every definition, two scenes, official retry TXT, input map, assembly, HUD and first behavior with parameters is subsequently created through actual Studio controls; no prepared game source, scene UUID or behavior metadata is injected.

Each first-creation binding retains ordinary raw parameter JSON. Source selection does not fill defaults; Add missing is explicit, followed by first-creation review and one behavior.create Save transaction.

The retained author-final workspace and frozen plan enable a separate actual Godot keyboard/HUD check. This browser report does not claim native gameplay, same-scene restart or independent distribution.
